description: Research Experiences for Undergraduates (REU), NHERI 2023: Assessing the Aerodynamics of Manufactured Homes Using Wind Tunnel Testing is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Arindam Gan Chowdhury, Florida International University (fiu.edu). This project discusses the wind tunnel test of a model manufacture home conducted at the Florida International University Wall of Wind Experimental Facility. From this project, we hope to improve the building and design codes for manufacture homes, improving their resistance to intense windstorms. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-nadh-en77. Keywords: NHERI Wall of Wind; Wind Engineering; Manufactured Homes; Wind Tunnels; Windstorms. Published 2023-08-23. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
